title: Podman on wsl not able to run any container
body:
### Issue Description

when doing a simple podman run command I get the following
`error: preparing container 1b55b27059bd4efd854443361de0d578c5a46b7e732280c20815e24362823aa5 for attach: netavark (exit code 1): nftables error: "nft" did not return successfully while applying ruleset:`


### Steps to reproduce the issue

Steps to reproduce the issue
1. Install podman via podman-desktop on windows 11
2. Try to run a podman command



### Describe the results you received

The container is not ran and there is an error

### Describe the results you expected

A running container

comments.body: Okay so actually, I had an old entry in %UserProfile%/.wslconfig that specified an older kernel file for my WSL distros, so it was using an older kernel.
